PROPERTY PARTNERS O’BRIEN SWAINE welcome you to 255 Boulevard, a spacious 3-bedroom, 3-storey mid-terrace property nestled in the heart of Tyrrelstown, Dublin 15. This beautiful home offers a perfect blend of modern comforts and convenience, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a contemporary living experience.

The property's three-storey layout provides a sense of space and separation, allowing for distinct living, sleeping, and entertaining areas.  The bedrooms are spacious and all 3 provide ensuites offering a comfortable retreat  ensuring privacy and relaxation

There is easy access to the property and convenient parking at the rear, ensuring that coming and going is a breeze for you and your guests.

The property is presented in good condition throughout and provides a sense of warmth and welcome from the moment you step inside.

Situated in the vibrant community of Tyrrelstown, this property benefits from a range of amenities nearby, including schools, shops, parks, and leisure facilities. With easy access to Dublin city centre and major transport links, you'll enjoy the best of both urban convenience and suburban tranquillity.

Accommodation includes: Entrance hall, WC, kitchen/ dining area, livingroom, 3 bedrooms and  3 ensuites
